name: Sunflower

name: Calendar

Use 'Today', 'Yesterday', and 'Tomorrow' markers to teach time sequencing.
Establish daily routines by actively manipulating numbers and tags during morning check-ins.

whenToUse.title: School Preparation
whenToUse.description: Use it to visually count down to school holidays or exams.

name: My Toilet Routine
description: A clear, waterproof visual sticker set designed to help children master bathroom habits step by step.
whyWeLoveIt: Clear Visual Guidance: Replaces overwhelming verbal instructions with 11 easy-to-follow picture steps.
Bathroom-Ready Durability: Printed on waterproof vinyl that sticks smoothly on clean surfaces and wipes clean easily with a damp cloth.
Builds Independence: Designed to be placed at eye level so children can lead their own routine and build daily confidence at their own pace.
whyToUse: Replaces overwhelming verbal instructions with 11 clear picture steps printed on durable, waterproof vinyl to build bathroom independence.
howToUse: Set Up the Sequence: Place the stickers in your bathroom at your child's eye level in exact chronological order (Steps 1 through 11).
Guide with Visuals: Point to each picture as your child performs the step, using simple, repeatable words.
Encourage Independence: Let your child try on their own before stepping in while providing support as needed, focusing on praising effort and building confidence.
Adapt as Needed: Always adjust the pace and the level of support according to your child's unique needs to ensure a stress-free learning environment.

whenToUse.title: Daily Bathroom Routine
whenToUse.description: Mount at eye level near the toilet and sink to provide a calm, predictable visual guide.

whenToUse.title: Routine Transitions
whenToUse.description: Use during potty training or daily routine changes to reduce anxiety and verbal reminders.

specifications.Variants: Available in Girl and Boy character designs
specifications.Step Count: 11 visual steps (covering pants down, toileting, wiping, flushing, clothing up, and hand washing)

Builds Independence: Designed to be placed at eye level so children can lead their own routine and learn at their own pace without pressure.
